## Lessons

::: {.unit-lesson}
12\. Solving quadratics by factorisation [Planned]{.planned}

Set the equation equal to zero and find its roots.

[Revisit first: 4–6, 10]{.prereq}
:::

::: {.unit-lesson}
13\. Modelling with quadratics [Planned]{.planned}

Build an equation from a problem and justify which roots make sense.

[Revisit first: 12]{.prereq}
:::

::: {.unit-lesson}
14\. Completing the square [Planned]{.planned}

Rewrite a quadratic in completed-square form and expand to check.

[Revisit first: 3, 5]{.prereq}
:::

::: {.unit-lesson}
15\. Solving by completing the square [Planned]{.planned}

Recover both roots and handle a leading coefficient other than one.

[Revisit first: 10, 14]{.prereq}
:::

::: {.unit-lesson}
16\. The quadratic formula [Planned]{.planned}

Substitute signed coefficients and give exact or approximate solutions.

[Revisit first: 2, 10, 12]{.prereq}
:::

::: {.unit-lesson}
17\. The discriminant and method choice [Planned]{.planned}

Predict the number of real roots and choose a solving method.

[Revisit first: 12, 15, 16]{.prereq}
:::
